'''Hydrade''' was a type of beverage that [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son, [[Ben Skywalker]], kept aboard their [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Jade Shadow]]'', during their quest to find out more about [[Darth Caedus]]' fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].<ref name="abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>
